items.q: he did the engagement with us in Chicago... I think Leo was with us for a short while. But for some reason, Leo left the band

ctx.x: exceptionally good musicians, and an exceptionally talented musician.

As a matter of fact, later, when Charlie Parker and Dizzy Gillespie heard him, they just loved him. He and Charlie Parker became very fast friends. And it was always said that you listen to Leo and you listen to Charlie Parker, it was 50-50, you know. Leo played tenor saxophone. But Leo was the kind of guy that he did everything Charlie Parker did, and they were like two peas in a pod for a long while.

Anyway, he did the engagement with us in Chicago, and after Chicago we went to New York in the Yacht Club, and I think Leo was with us for a short while. But for some reason, Leo left the band, and the alto saxophone player, Harry Curtis, got drafted into the Navy. So we got another kid who had grown up in Washington but was living in Baltimore at that particular time, and his name was William Swindell. We got him to play alto saxophone in Harry Curtis's place.
